name: Science Academia

influenced_by: dark academia (applied to lab/STEM settings instead of humanities)

reacts_against: dark academia's humanities-only focus, bringing the same moody aesthetic to laboratories and scientific notebooks instead.

findings: dark — about 52% of the measured color across 6 wiki photos is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 98% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
